Settings.QueryText: SELECT Accommodation.RoomType AS RoomType, Accommodation.RoomType.Code AS RoomTypeCode, Accommodation.GuestGroup AS GuestGroup, Accommodation.GuestGroup.Code AS GuestGroupCode, Accommodation.GuestGroup.Description AS GuestGroupDescription, Accommodation.GuestGroup.ID AS GuestGroupID, Accommodation.GuestGroup.ColorHexString AS GuestGroupColorHexString, Accommodation.Customer AS Customer, ISNULL(Accommodation.Customer.ColorHexString, "") AS CustomerColorHexString, Accommodation.Contract AS Contract, ISNULL(Accommodation.Contract.ColorHexString, "") AS ContractColorHexString, Accommodation.Agent AS Agent, ISNULL(Accommodation.Agent.ColorHexString, "") AS AgentColorHexString, Accommodation.NumberOfPersons AS NumberOfPersons, Accommodation.SourceOfBusiness.Code AS SourceOfBusinessCode, Accommodation.SourceOfBusiness AS SourceOfBusiness, Accommodation.MarketingCode.Code AS MarketingCodeCode, Accommodation.MarketingCode AS MarketingCode, Accommodation.ClientType AS ClientType, Accommodation.ClientType.Code AS ClientTypeCode, ISNULL(Accommodation.ClientType.ColorHexString, "") AS ClientTypeColorHexString, Accommodation.Guest.FullName AS GuestFullName, Accommodation.Guest AS Guest, Accommodation.Guest.IsInWhiteList AS VIP, Accommodation.Guest.MilitaryRank AS Rank, DiscountTypes.Ref AS DiscountCardDiscountType, ISNULL(DiscountTypes.ColorHexString, "") AS DiscountCardDiscountTypeColorHexString, Accommodation.Guest.DateOfBirth AS GuestDateOfBirth, Accommodation.Guest.Citizenship.ISOCode AS GuestCitizenshipISOCode, Accommodation.Guest.Age AS GuestAge, Accommodation.Guest.AgeRange AS GuestAgeRange, CASE WHEN Accommodation.Guest.Sex = VALUE(Enum.Sex.Male) THEN 26 WHEN Accommodation.Guest.Sex = VALUE(Enum.Sex.Female) THEN 27 ELSE 0 END AS GuestSexIcon, CASE WHEN Accommodation.Phone <> "" THEN Accommodation.Phone ELSE Accommodation.Guest.Phone END AS Phone, CASE WHEN Accommodation.EMail <> "" THEN Accommodation.EMail ELSE Accommodation.Guest.EMail END AS EMail, Accommodation.AccommodationType AS AccommodationType, CASE WHEN ISNULL(Accommodation.HotelProduct.IsFolder, FALSE) THEN UNDEFINED ELSE Accommodation.HotelProduct END AS Vaucher, Accommodation.CheckInDate AS CheckInDate, Accommodation.Duration AS Duration, Accommodation.CheckOutDate AS CheckOutDate, BEGINOFPERIOD(Accommodation.CheckInDate, DAY) AS BegOfCheckInDate, BEGINOFPERIOD(Accommodation.CheckOutDate, DAY) AS BegOfCheckOutDate, CASE WHEN Accommodation.RoomRate.DefaultCheckInTime <> DATETIME(1, 1, 1) AND HOUR(Accommodation.CheckInDate) * 100 + MINUTE(Accommodation.CheckInDate) = HOUR(Accommodation.RoomRate.DefaultCheckInTime) * 100 + MINUTE(Accommodation.RoomRate.DefaultCheckInTime) THEN TRUE WHEN Accommodation.RoomRate.ReferenceHour <> DATETIME(1, 1, 1) AND Accommodation.RoomRate.DefaultCheckInTime = DATETIME(1, 1, 1) AND HOUR(Accommodation.CheckInDate) * 100 + MINUTE(Accommodation.CheckInDate) = HOUR(Accommodation.RoomRate.ReferenceHour) * 100 + MINUTE(Accommodation.RoomRate.ReferenceHour) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS IsDefaultCheckInTime, CASE WHEN Accommodation.RoomRate.ReferenceHour <> DATETIME(1, 1, 1) AND HOUR(Accommodation.CheckOutDate) * 100 + MINUTE(Accommodation.CheckOutDate) = HOUR(Accommodation.RoomRate.ReferenceHour) * 100 + MINUTE(Accommodation.RoomRate.ReferenceHour) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS IsDefaultCheckOutTime, CAST(Accommodation.Remarks AS STRING(512)) AS Remarks, CAST(Accommodation.HousekeepingRemarks AS STRING(512)) AS HousekeepingRemarks, CAST(Accommodation.Car AS STRING(512)) AS Car, Accommodation.Room AS Room, Accommodation.PlannedPaymentMethod.Code AS PaymentMethod, CASE WHEN Accommodation.AccommodationStatus.IsActive THEN CASE WHEN Accommodation.AccommodationStatus.IsCheckIn AND Accommodation.AccommodationStatus.IsInHouse THEN 41 WHEN Accommodation.AccommodationStatus.IsRoomChange AND Accommodation.AccommodationStatus.IsInHouse THEN 39 ELSE 40 END ELSE 43 END AS IndexRoomStatuses, Accommodation.AccommodationType.SortCode AS AccommodationTypeSortCode, Accommodation.GuaranteeType AS GuaranteeType, Accommodation.GuaranteeType.Code AS GuaranteeTypeCode, Accommodation.Room.SortCode AS RoomSortCode, Accommodation.AccommodationStatus AS AccommodationStatus, Accommodation.AccommodationType.Type AS AccommodationTypeType, Accommodation.ServicePackage AS ServicePackage, Accommodation.Ref AS Ref, Accommodation.Number AS RefNumber, Accommodation.Date AS RefDate, Accommodation.RoomRate AS RoomRate, Accommodation.RoomQuota AS RoomQuota, ISNULL(Accommodation.RoomQuota.ColorHexString, "") AS RoomQuotaColorHexString, CAST(Accommodation.RoomPropertiesCodes AS STRING(512)) AS RoomPropertiesCodes, CAST(Accommodation.RoomPropertiesDescriptions AS STRING(512)) AS RoomPropertiesDescriptions, 0 AS ClientSumBalance, 0 AS ClientLimitBalance, 0 AS CustomerSumBalance, Accommodation.ReportingCurrency AS FolioCurrency, Accommodation.AccommodationTemplate AS AccommodationTemplate, Accommodation.NumberOfAdults AS NumberOfAdults, Accommodation.NumberOfTeenagers AS NumberOfTeenagers, Accommodation.NumberOfChildren AS NumberOfChildren, Accommodation.NumberOfInfants AS NumberOfInfants, Accommodation.Number AS DocNumber, Accommodation.Author AS Author, Accommodation.Posted AS Posted, Accommodation.DeletionMark AS DeletionMark, Accommodation.SortCode AS SortCode, Accommodation.Company AS Company, Accommodation.RoomTypeUpgrade AS RoomTypeUpgrade, Accommodation.RoomTypeUpgrade.Code AS RoomTypeUpgradeCode, CAST(Accommodation.PricePresentation AS STRING(50)) AS PricePresentation, CASE WHEN NOT Accommodation.RoomTypeUpgrade.Code IS NULL AND Accommodation.RoomTypeUpgrade <> Accommodation.RoomType THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS RoomTypeUpgradeIsDone, Accommodation.BedsSetup AS BedsSetup, &qShowAllGuests AS ShowAllGuests, &qBalancesAreVisible AS BalancesAreVisible, 0 AS RowColorIndex FROM Document.Accommodation AS Accommodation LEFT JOIN Catalog.DiscountTypes AS DiscountTypes ON Accommodation.DiscountCard.DiscountType = DiscountTypes.Ref WHERE &qGenerateList AND Accommodation.Hotel = &qHotel

SELECT DISTINCT ReservationChangesPlan1.Ref AS Ref, DATEADD(ReservationChangesPlan1.AccountingDate, DAY, 1) AS BookedOutEndDate, BookedOutReservations.BookedOutDate AS BookedOutDate INTO BookedOutEndReservations FROM Document.Reservation.RoomRates AS ReservationChangesPlan1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ReservationChangesPlan2.Ref AS Ref, ReservationChangesPlan2.AccountingDate AS BookedOutDate FROM Document.Reservation.RoomRates AS ReservationChangesPlan2 WHERE ReservationChangesPlan2.IsBookedOut AND ReservationChangesPlan2.AccountingDate = BEGINOFPERIOD(&qDateTo, DAY) AND ReservationChangesPlan2.Ref.Hotel = &qHotel AND ReservationChangesPlan2.Ref.Posted AND ReservationChangesPlan2.Ref.ReservationStatus.IsActive) AS BookedOutReservations ON ReservationChangesPlan1.Ref = BookedOutReservations.Ref WHERE ReservationChangesPlan1.IsBookedOut AND ReservationChangesPlan1.Ref.Hotel = &qHotel AND BookedOutReservations.BookedOutDate IS NULL AND ReservationChangesPlan1.AccountingDate = DATEADD(BEGINOFPERIOD(&qDateTo, DAY), DAY, -1) AND ReservationChangesPlan1.Ref.Posted AND ReservationChangesPlan1.Ref.ReservationStatus.IsActive AND &qDateTo <> DATETIME(1, 1, 1) ;
//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// SELECT Reservations.RoomType AS RoomType, Reservations.RoomType.Code AS RoomTypeCode, Reservations.GuestGroup AS GuestGroup, Reservations.GuestGroup.Code AS GuestGroupCode, Reservations.GuestGroup.Description AS GuestGroupDescription, Reservations.GuestGroup.ID AS GuestGroupID, Reservations.GuestGroup.ColorHexString AS GuestGroupColorHexString, Reservations.Customer AS Customer, ISNULL(Reservations.Customer.ColorHexString, "") AS CustomerColorHexString, Reservations.Contract AS Contract, ISNULL(Reservations.Contract.ColorHexString, "") AS ContractColorHexString, Reservations.Agent AS Agent, ISNULL(Reservations.Agent.ColorHexString, "") AS AgentColorHexString, Reservations.NumberOfPersons AS NumberOfPersons, Reservations.SourceOfBusiness.Code AS SourceOfBusinessCode, Reservations.SourceOfBusiness AS SourceOfBusiness, Reservations.MarketingCode.Code AS MarketingCodeCode, Reservations.MarketingCode AS MarketingCode, Reservations.ClientType AS ClientType, Reservations.ClientType.Code AS ClientTypeCode, ISNULL(Reservations.ClientType.ColorHexString, "") AS ClientTypeColorHexString, Reservations.Guest.FullName AS GuestFullName, Reservations.Guest AS Guest, Reservations.Guest.IsInWhiteList AS VIP, Reservations.Guest.MilitaryRank AS Rank, DiscountTypes.Ref AS DiscountCardDiscountType, ISNULL(DiscountTypes.ColorHexString, "") AS DiscountCardDiscountTypeColorHexString, Reservations.Guest.Citizenship.ISOCode AS GuestCitizenshipISOCode, Reservations.Guest.DateOfBirth AS GuestDateOfBirth, CASE WHEN Reservations.Guest <> VALUE(Catalog.Clients.EmptyRef) THEN CASE WHEN Reservations.Guest.DateOfBirth > DATETIME(1, 1, 1) AND (DATEADD(Reservations.Guest.DateOfBirth, YEAR, DATEDIFF(Reservations.Guest.DateOfBirth, Reservations.CheckInDate, YEAR)) BETWEEN BEGINOFPERIOD(Reservations.CheckInDate, DAY) AND Reservations.CheckOutDate) THEN 55 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS BirthDateIcon, Reservations.Guest.Age AS GuestAge, Reservations.Guest.AgeRange AS GuestAgeRange, CASE WHEN Reservations.Guest.Sex = VALUE(Enum.Sex.Male) THEN 26 WHEN Reservations.Guest.Sex = VALUE(Enum.Sex.Female) THEN 27 ELSE 0 END AS GuestSexIcon, CASE WHEN Reservations.Phone <> "" THEN Reservations.Phone ELSE Reservations.Guest.Phone END AS Phone, CASE WHEN Reservations.EMail <> "" THEN Reservations.EMail ELSE Reservations.Guest.EMail END AS EMail, Reservations.Guest.IdentityDocumentSeries AS GuestPassportSeries, Reservations.Guest.IdentityDocumentNumber AS GuestPassportNumber, Reservations.AccommodationType AS AccommodationType, CASE WHEN ISNULL(Reservations.HotelProduct.IsFolder, FALSE) THEN UNDEFINED ELSE Reservations.HotelProduct END AS Vaucher, Reservations.CheckInDate AS CheckInDate, Reservations.Duration AS Duration, Reservations.CheckOutDate AS CheckOutDate, CASE WHEN NOT BookedOutEndReservations.BookedOutEndDate IS NULL THEN BookedOutEndReservations.BookedOutEndDate ELSE BEGINOFPERIOD(Reservations.CheckInDate, DAY) END AS BegOfCheckInDate, BEGINOFPERIOD(Reservations.CheckOutDate, DAY) AS BegOfCheckOutDate, CASE WHEN Reservations.RoomRate.DefaultCheckInTime <> DATETIME(1, 1, 1) AND HOUR(Reservations.CheckInDate) * 100 + MINUTE(Reservations.CheckInDate) = HOUR(Reservations.RoomRate.DefaultCheckInTime) * 100 + MINUTE(Reservations.RoomRate.DefaultCheckInTime) THEN TRUE WHEN Reservations.RoomRate.ReferenceHour <> DATETIME(1, 1, 1) AND Reservations.RoomRate.DefaultCheckInTime = DATETIME(1, 1, 1) AND HOUR(Reservations.CheckInDate) * 100 + MINUTE(Reservations.CheckInDate) = HOUR(Reservations.RoomRate.ReferenceHour) * 100 + MINUTE(Reservations.RoomRate.ReferenceHour) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS IsDefaultCheckInTime, CASE WHEN Reservations.RoomRate.ReferenceHour <> DATETIME(1, 1, 1) AND HOUR(Reservations.CheckOutDate) * 100 + MINUTE(Reservations.CheckOutDate) = HOUR(Reservations.RoomRate.ReferenceHour) * 100 + MINUTE(Reservations.RoomRate.ReferenceHour) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS IsDefaultCheckOutTime, CASE WHEN BEGINOFPERIOD(Reservations.CheckInDate, DAY) < Reservations.Hotel.AccountingDate THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS IsLateCheckIn, Reservations.Remarks AS Remarks, Reservations.HousekeepingRemarks AS HousekeepingRemarks, Reservations.Car AS Car, Reservations.Room AS Room, Reservations.Room.RoomStatus AS RoomRoomStatus, CASE WHEN Reservations.Room.RoomStatus.RoomStatusIcon = VALUE(Enum.RoomStatusesIcons.None) THEN 5 WHEN Reservations.Room.RoomStatus.RoomStatusIcon = VALUE(Enum.RoomStatusesIcons.Reserved) THEN 6 WHEN Reservations.Room.RoomStatus.RoomStatusIcon = VALUE(Enum.RoomStatusesIcons.Occupied) THEN 2 WHEN Reservations.Room.RoomStatus.RoomStatusIcon = VALUE(Enum.RoomStatusesIcons.OccupiedDirty) THEN 7 WHEN Reservations.Room.RoomStatus.RoomStatusIcon = VALUE(Enum.RoomStatusesIcons.Repair) THEN 8 WHEN Reservations.Room.RoomStatus.RoomStatusIcon = VALUE(Enum.RoomStatusesIcons.Luggage) THEN 9 WHEN Reservations.Room.RoomStatus.RoomStatusIcon = VALUE(Enum.RoomStatusesIcons.Malfunction) THEN 10 WHEN Reservations.Room.RoomStatus.RoomStatusIcon = VALUE(Enum.RoomStatusesIcons.Waiting) THEN 1 WHEN Reservations.Room.RoomStatus.RoomStatusIcon = VALUE(Enum.RoomStatusesIcons.TidyingUp) THEN 0 WHEN Reservations.Room.RoomStatus.RoomStatusIcon = VALUE(Enum.RoomStatusesIcons.CheckOut) THEN 3 WHEN Reservations.Room.RoomStatus.RoomStatusIcon = VALUE(Enum.RoomStatusesIcons.Vacant) THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS RoomStatusIcon, Reservations.AccommodationType.SortCode AS AccommodationTypeSortCode, Reservations.Room.SortCode AS RoomSortCode, Reservations.AccommodationType.Type AS AccommodationTypeType, Reservations.ReservationStatus AS ReservationStatus, ReservationStatuses.ColorHexString AS ReservationStatusColorHexString, Reservations.GuaranteeType AS GuaranteeType, Reservations.GuaranteeType.Code AS GuaranteeTypeCode, Reservations.PlannedPaymentMethod.Code AS PaymentMethod, Reservations.Ref AS Ref, Reservations.Number AS RefNumber, Reservations.Date AS RefDate, Reservations.RoomRate AS RoomRate, Reservations.ServicePackage AS ServicePackage, Reservations.RoomQuota AS RoomQuota, ISNULL(Reservations.RoomQuota.ColorHexString, "") AS RoomQuotaColorHexString, Reservations.RoomPropertiesCodes AS RoomPropertiesCodes, Reservations.RoomPropertiesDescriptions AS RoomPropertiesDescriptions, 0 AS ClientSumBalance, 0 AS ClientLimitBalance, 0 AS CustomerSumBalance, Reservations.ReportingCurrency AS FolioCurrency, CASE WHEN Reservations.ParentDoc <> UNDEFINED THEN 53 WHEN ReservationStatuses.IsInWaitingList THEN 54 WHEN ReservationStatuses.IsActive THEN CASE WHEN ReservationStatuses.IsGuaranteed THEN 44 ELSE 42 END WHEN ReservationStatuses.IsCheckIn THEN 36 WHEN ReservationStatuses.IsNoShow THEN 51 WHEN ReservationStatuses.IsPreliminary THEN 35 ELSE 43 END AS IDIconStatus, Reservations.AccommodationTemplate AS AccommodationTemplate, Reservations.NumberOfAdults AS NumberOfAdults, Reservations.NumberOfTeenagers AS NumberOfTeenagers, Reservations.NumberOfChildren AS NumberOfChildren, Reservations.NumberOfInfants AS NumberOfInfants, Reservations.RoomQuantity AS RoomQuantity, CAST(Reservations.PricePresentation AS STRING(50)) AS PricePresentation, Reservations.RoomTypeUpgrade AS RoomTypeUpgrade, Reservations.RoomTypeUpgrade.Code AS RoomTypeUpgradeCode, CASE WHEN NOT Reservations.RoomTypeUpgrade.Code IS NULL AND Reservations.RoomTypeUpgrade <> Reservations.RoomType THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS RoomTypeUpgradeIsDone, Reservations.Number AS DocNumber, Reservations.Author AS Author, Reservations.Posted AS Posted, Reservations.DeletionMark AS DeletionMark, Reservations.SortCode AS SortCode, Reservations.Company AS Company, Reservations.BedsSetup AS BedsSetup, &qShowAllGuests AS ShowAllGuests, &qBalancesAreVisible AS BalancesAreVisible, ReservationStatusChangeHistoryRecords.Period AS SetReservationStatusDate, 0 AS RowColorIndex FROM Document.Reservation AS Reservations LEFT JOIN Catalog.ReservationStatuses AS ReservationStatuses ON Reservations.ReservationStatus = ReservationStatuses.Ref LEFT JOIN Catalog.DiscountTypes AS DiscountTypes ON Reservations.DiscountCard.DiscountType = DiscountTypes.Ref LEFT JOIN InformationRegister.ReservationChangeHistory.SliceLast( , CASE WHEN &qShowWaitingListOnly THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) AS ReservationStatusChangeHistoryRecords ON (ReservationStatusChangeHistoryRecords.Reservation = Reservations.Ref) LEFT JOIN BookedOutEndReservations AS BookedOutEndReservations ON Reservations.Ref = BookedOutEndReservations.Ref WHERE Reservations.Posted AND &qGenerateList AND ReservationStatuses.IsActive AND NOT ReservationStatuses.IsArrivalSchedule AND Reservations.Hotel = &qHotel AND Reservations.CheckInDate <= &qDateTo AND CASE WHEN &qShowWaitingListOnly THEN ReservationStatuses.IsInWaitingList ELSE TRUE END
